newsitem.title: UK: Britain picks preferred bid for MOD support unit.
newsitem.headline: Britain picks preferred bid for MOD support unit.

text.p: Britain's defence ministry said it had singled out venture capital group Apax Partners & Co from over 20 potential bidders for its Defence Evaluation and Research Agency's Support Services Division.
It said Apax had been granted a period of exclusivity to carry out due diligence and to conclude a contract with DERA on the basis of their offer.
The ministry said it expected the sale to be completed by mid-February.
DERA incorporates the bulk of the defence ministry's non-nuclear research, technology and test and evaluation establishments and provides advice to the ministry on equipment procurement.
Its support services division covers financial systems, information technology and site services and has 1,300 staff with a turnover of 130 million stg.
Apax intends to work with exsiting management, the statement said.
